run_play_game: run the play.py module to start a StarCraft II game with a specified map and bot configuration
run_replay_viewer: run the play.py module to watch a StarCraft II replay file with pygame rendering enabled
run_video_recording: run the play.py module to record a StarCraft II game session to a video file at a given path
run_profile_game: run the play.py module with profiling enabled to measure StarCraft II game execution performance
run_replay_with_custom_map: run the play.py module to view a replay while overriding the map path to a different local map
